name: macem
description: Lets Claude look at what macEM's windows show on this Mac: images, results and the output log. It runs analyses only when you allow that in macEM's Settings > Agents.
long_description: macEM is the MCP server itself, on this Mac only (127.0.0.1). This extension carries Claude's requests to it. In macEM, turn on Settings > Agents, press Copy Connection Command and paste the copied line below. The extension talks to no other computer.

connection.title: Connection command
connection.description: In macEM: Settings > Agents > Copy Connection Command, then paste it here.
